en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. In the foreground, three people sit in a wooden boat on a calm river with other small boats nearby. On the opposite bank rises a large Renaissance-style castle complex with white walls, red roofs, and a tall tower. To the right, a metal bridge spans the river. Trees and a gently sloping embankment frame the scene. Printed German text at the top reads "Torgau." on the left and "Blick von der Elbe." on the right, with a handwritten red number above.
